chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from some of our companions, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
When you mention the Name of Allah during wudu (ablution), your entire body becomes pure; and if you do not mention it, nothing of your body becomes pure except that over which the water has passed.

key_terms.سَمَّيْتَ: you mentioned the Name of Allah, i.e. performed tasmiyah
key_terms.ٱلْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before acts of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of saying the Name of Allah during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that mentioning the Name of Allah during wudu (ablution) causes purity to extend to the whole body, whereas without it, purity is limited to the parts touched by water. It highlights the spiritual significance of tasmiyah within the act of ritual purification.
